newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli helicopters raid area south of Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Israeli helicopters raid area south of Beirut.

text.p: Israeli helicopters raided on Thursday suspected radical Palestinean guerrilla positions at an area close to Beirut, witnesses said.

The witnesses in the costal town of Naameh, 15 km (nine miles) south of Beirut, said two Israeli helicopters fired a total of four rockets at suspected positions of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine General Command.
A guerrilla spokesman confirmed the Israeli attack and said two civilians were wounded.
